sources.title: GitHub - huchukato/ComfyUI-QwenVL-Mod: ComfyUI-QwenVL custom node ...
sources.snippet: The ComfyUI-QwenVL custom node integrates powerful Qwen-VL series of vision-language models (LVLMs) from Alibaba Cloud, including latest Qwen3-VL, plus GGUF backends and text-only Qwen3 support. This advanced node enables seamless multimodal AI capabilities within your ComfyUI workflows, allowing for efficient text generation, image understanding, and video analysis.
